However, if your mother’s reaction was negative (e.g., she refused to buy you new clothes or criticized your action), it might be worth reflecting on whether your mother’s approval was a primary concern rather than the act of charity itself. Islam encourages balance—helping others should not come at the cost of unnecessary conflict or selfish motives.
